Priced like we plan
to discharge you
Most insurers billed directly; self-payers get the same prices you see here, because they're the only prices that exist.
· Hands-on where it earns its keep
· Valid four months, shareable with no one, sorry
No referral needed. Wear something you can move in, bring any scans you have (we'll read them, then mostly reassure you about them), and budget a full hour.
Tea, forms already done online, and the only question that matters: what can't you do right now that you want back?
Movement exam. Bend, squat, reach, hop. We watch like coaches, not examiners.
The explanation, in plain words, with the spine model only if you ask nicely.
First exercises, filmed on your phone so future-you can't claim amnesia.
The plan: how many sessions, how spaced, what done looks like.
No. Come straight in. If anything needs a doctor's eyes, we write the letter and tell you exactly why.
Rehab flirts with the edge of discomfort; it shouldn't live past it. You set the ceiling, we set the dose.
Hands-on work happens when it helps you move better, not as the main event. If you want only massage, we know a great one next door.
How fast can I be seen?
Next working day for most weekdays; same day for the genuinely stuck. Say 'I cannot turn my head' and watch the diary open.
Above the bakery, which is either a cruel test or the perfect reward system. Lift access, bike racks, showers.
